title: Effectiveness and Progress of Roll-out of Money Lock Feature in Protecting Consumers from Scams and Unauthorised Bank Transactions
what_it_is: Effectiveness and Progress of Roll-out of Money Lock Feature in Protecting Consumers from Scams and Unauthorised Bank Transactions

sections.label: Money Lock accounts uptake
sections.summary: Over 61,000 Money Lock accounts hold more than $5.4 billion, with other major retail banks to introduce the feature by mid-year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Since its launch by local banks in November last year, more than 61,000 Money Lock accounts have been set up, with over $5.4 billion of savings set aside in February 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Other major retail banks will introduce the Money Lock feature by the middle of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: For instance, instead of requiring customers to set up a new bank account to use Money Lock, DBS now allows customers to lock up funds within the same bank account.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Locked funds will continue to earn the prevailing interest rate in that account.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: To date, there have been no reports of phishing or malware scams involving funds under Money Lock.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) will work with the banks to continue to encourage customers to adopt Money Lock, and also to monitor the effectiveness of Money Lock.
